activity.notes: After his farm was burned in 1515, Pier Gerlofs Donia joined resistance in Friesland, helped form the Arumer Zwarte Hoop, became leader of the seagoing fighters, and fought as a pirate on the Zuiderzee. Later accounts place his retirement and transfer of command to Wijerd Jelckama in 1519; the end boundary is therefore marked approximate.

sources.title: Grutte Pier — Fries Museum
sources.citation_text: Places Donia's turn to armed resistance in 1515, names the Arumer Zwarte Hoop, and identifies him as leader of the seagoing fighters and a pirate on the Zuiderzee.
